purpose: Read-only city source research and bounded public-service validation; no global/runtime/catalog integration.
assessment: The official Gwangju Metropolitan City WFS is a genuine anonymous continuous-cadastre vector source. The repository adapter qualification passed all 19 checks over 54 unique polygons and 13 bounded cells. Independent Shapely topology QA found 53 valid geometries and one self-intersecting polygon; the stored three-polygon sample excludes that invalid feature.
registryAssessment: The Gwangju Metropolitan City Living Geographic Information Portal exposes the city continuous cadastral (`연속지적도`) layer through an anonymous WFS. Its schema includes PNU and geometry; bounded queries requested only those fields and returned complete multipolygons.

searchQueries.query: Gwangju Metropolitan City South Korea cadastral parcel WFS GIS official map portal
searchQueries.scope: Find the metropolitan city’s official parcel mapping service and public vector route.
searchQueries.result: Search results contained an unrelated Gwangju City in Gyeonggi Province; that portal was excluded. Direct review of the Gwangju Metropolitan City GIS portal and its public WFS exposed the continuous cadastral layer `sde:lsmd_cont_ldreg`; the bounded WFS returned full polygons.
searchQueries.executionMethod: English-language web search followed by anonymous official portal, WFS capabilities/schema and bounded-query inspection.

searchQueries.query: 광주광역시 생활지리정보시스템 지도서비스 지적도 토지정보 공식 광주광역시청
searchQueries.scope: 광주광역시의 공식 지리정보 포털과 연속지적도 공개 서비스를 확인한다.
searchQueries.result: 광주광역시 생활지리정보 포털은 `연속지적도` 레이어를 `sde:lsmd_cont_ldreg` WFS로 공개한다. 익명 제한 조회는 PNU와 전체 MultiPolygon 경계만 반환했다. 경기도 광주시의 동명 포털은 제외했다.
searchQueries.executionMethod: 별도 한국어 웹 검색 후 공식 포털, WFS Capabilities/DescribeFeatureType 및 제한 조회를 검사.

officialSources.observation: Official city GIS portal (not Gwangju-si in Gyeonggi Province). Portal lists parcel/cadastral map functions, including land ledger/map tools; legal disclaimer says map is for reference and may differ from actual/legal records.

officialSources.operator: Gwangju Metropolitan City GIS portal WFS proxy
officialSources.observation: Anonymous WFS 1.1.0 capabilities and schema expose `sde:lsmd_cont_ldreg` (`연속지적`) in EPSG:5186; safe requested attributes were limited to `pnu` plus geometry.

viewerAndServiceTrace.queryMode: Anonymous WFS 1.1.0, CRS:84 bounds and response, 0.001-degree bounded city grid; propertyName geom,pnu. EPSG:5186 is advertised by capabilities; qualification/independent topology metric reprojection used EPSG:3857.
viewerAndServiceTrace.schema: DescribeFeatureType lists sgg_oid, jibun, bchk, pnu and geom; only pnu and geometry were requested.
viewerAndServiceTrace.legalMapNote: Portal states map is reference material, may differ from reality and has no legal effect.

geometryDecision: Three individually valid safe-identifier polygons are retained in the sample file. The source adapter tests passed, but the one topologically invalid feature means the city candidate should remain pending parent review; no geometry was repaired and no runtime/catalog integration was performed.
remainingUncertainty: The source’s citywide coverage, update cadence, legal status, and long-term PNU stability are undocumented. One source polygon has a self-intersecting ring.
runtimeAssessment: Research candidate only; no runtime or global registry integration performed.
rootAssessment: Independent root GEOS audit in EPSG:32652 reproduces a ring self-intersection in native PNU 1224012100107000001 among 54 complete public source polygons. All 19 protocol checks passed, but runtime remains held without repair or excluding the failing parcel. A native EPSG:5186 follow-up returned HTML maintenance/error content rather than parcel geometry; native-coordinate validity remains unestablished.
